description: This file defines an exception class 'PolicyIdNotAccessibleException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It represents an error condition where the Policy ID of a 'Thing' was either missing or access was insufficient. The class includes constructors, a builder pattern for creating instances, and static methods for instantiation from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: PolicyIdNotAccessibleException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when the Policy ID of a Thing is inaccessible due to absence or permissions issues.

classes.name: PolicyIdNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of PolicyIdNotAccessibleException with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance by parsing a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
